question_text: In an experiment to find Young's modulus, three different wires $W_1$, $W_2$ and $W_3$ of the same material have been used and different tensile force $F$ with extension $\Delta L$ as shown in the figure. Which of the following statements made for the reason of obtaining obtained graphs is true?

options.option_text: The wire $W_1$ may have the same length as $W_2$, but a smaller area of cross-section.
The wire $W_2$ may have a larger length and a smaller area of cross-section than $W_1$.
The wire $W_3$ may have the same area of cross-section, but a larger length than that of $W_1$.
The wire $W_1$ may have a smaller area of cross-section as well as length larger than $W_1$.
The wire $W_1$ may have a larger value for the ratio, Area of cross-section/length than $W_1$.
